free_parameters.name: block_size
free_parameters.why: cache block size from the scheduler Config; it enters the target only as the multiplier in (free_blocks * block_size) // 32

free_parameters.name: num_gpu_blocks_per_budget
free_parameters.why: num_gpu_blocks = 2 * memory_budget makes (num_gpu_blocks * 16) // 32 exactly equal to the requested memory_budget

free_parameters.name: prompt_tokens
free_parameters.why: one small prompt keeps the waiting queue non-empty so the entry reaches the slack search; its length does not affect the memory_budget guard

free_parameters.name: chunk_size
free_parameters.why: DeadlineSchedulerConfig chunk size; it only shapes the post-target prefill loop, not the memory_budget decision

free_parameters.name: max_tokens
free_parameters.why: sampling parameter required to construct a Sequence; it is not read before or at the target line

free_parameters.name: model_max_model_len
free_parameters.why: max_model_len used by the block manager prompt-length check; the 64-token prompt is far below it

free_parameters.name: seq_tier
free_parameters.why: fixes the randomly assigned request tier so the post-target deadline arithmetic is deterministic

free_parameters.name: seq_ttft_deadline
free_parameters.why: keeps the post-target eager-relegation branch off the wall-clock boundary; the target decision reads only memory_budget

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed random seed so Sequence tier assignment and the whole run are reproducible

free_parameters.name: metrics_write
free_parameters.why: MetricsStore is initialised in disabled mode, matching the CPU-only scheduler-only setup
